memory_update.text: PANW should be stored as reference anchor only for identity-security platformization after CyberArk acquisition; do not treat as underfollowed discovery.

node: Cloud cybersecurity control-plane software: identity, secrets, API security, OT security, and compliance automation
summary: Expanded one supply-chain node using a two-lane Serenity funnel. Reference lane: Palo Alto Networks is now the obvious listed anchor for enterprise identity-security platformization after completing CyberArk acquisition on February 11, 2026, but it is high-attention and not the alpha-discovery focus. Underfollowed lane: Tenable, Qualys, OneSpan, and Rapid7 are smaller US-listed candidates with plausible second-order exposure to OT security, FedRAMP/compliance automation, regulated identity workflows, cloud/application security, and security data/control-plane consolidation. These are research candidates only, not recommendations.
